claims.text: This trip was booked on an UPFRONT_QUOTE: the fare was fixed at SGD 22.00 at booking, yet the rider was charged SGD 25.20 — SGD 3.20 more than the quote, and the whole of that difference is a single ERP line. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges on an upfront trip were fixed at booking and cannot move, so the only live question is whether the pass-through lines billed on top of the quote were properly chargeable.

POL-RD-11(a) measures the rider's remedy as charged_total less quoted_fare_sgd less the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. The fare_breakdown's own arithmetic publishes properly_chargeable.total at SGD 0.00 — no ERP line crossed, no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee — so the remedy is the full SGD 3.20 by which the SGD 25.20 charged exceeds the SGD 22.00 quote, and the published pol_rd_11_remedy is SGD 3.20.

The ERP line is a phantom line on this trip's own trace. The charged gantry, 'Bukit Merah Central westbound', sits at lat 1.34, lng 103.78; the closest any of the trace's 169 fixes comes to it is 7,482.07 m (fix index 65, 2026-09-21T11:40:50) — roughly thirty times the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09(4) applies — and the derived facts record gap_brackets_closest_approach false and on_optimal_route false. A charge line for a gantry the trace never passes is a billing-integrity failure refunded in full under POL-RD-09(4), and that correction is available whether or not a deviation exists.

The driver does not contest the gantry point. His statement on file records that the route was longer than expected but that he 'did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt'. That is a party admission on the very line in dispute, and it corroborates the billing-integrity defect independently of the platform trace.

The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The POL-RD-01 governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 16.0 km, against the booked optimal of 12.5 km — an excess of 3.5 km, or 28.00%. Both establishment tests pass: 28.00% is above the 20% threshold and 3.5 km is above the 0.8 km threshold. That discharges the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) and (b) on matching identifiers and a threshold-meeting excess.

Because POL-RD-11 governs this upfront-quoted trip, POL-RD-02 does not run and the rider claims no distance-or-time refund — the rider is not asking for money the upfront quote never put at risk. The remedy sought is the pass-through correction alone, which is why the amount claimed is exactly the contested SGD 3.20.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 169 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, and max_gap_sec of 0.0, with an admissibility status of COMPLETE at weight 1.0. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are therefore not met, the excess stands on the trace itself without independent corroboration, and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged.

No traffic advisory covers this trip window, so nothing in the bundle reduces the measured excess or supplies an amended optimal under POL-RD-03. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09114-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no payload — I disclose that impairment expressly — and its absence is itself citable. It leaves the driver with no exculpatory clause to invoke under POL-RD-08, and under POL-RD-13 an uncited traffic explanation carries no weight against the trace figure.

The rider-side corroboration rule in POL-RD-08 is nowhere near engaged: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far below the four-claim trigger, so the trace figure needs no supporting source beyond itself.

The refund the rider seeks does not depend on materiality or on a repeat pattern, and I do not overstate either: POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation here but not a MATERIAL one — 28.00% is below the 50% gate and 3.5 km below the 8.0 km gate — and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, with deviation_flags_90d at 0 against 610 completed trips in 90 days, yields no pattern. The billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) is owed on this record either way.

The whole of the contested SGD 3.20 is returned to the rider, so the outcome for the filing party is FULL_REFUND under POL-GEN-03, and the phantom-gantry charge should additionally be recorded as a billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4). That referral adds to the monetary ruling and does not suppress it, and POL-RD-10(8) is not triggered because the only unmatched line in the fare_breakdown is the one already refunded under POL-RD-09(4).

This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: EV-FARE-09114 carries fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 22.00 against a total_charged of 25.20, so under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run on this trip, and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however large the measured excess. The driver keeps the quoted 22.00 and the rider's exposure is confined to the single pass-through line.

The excess is 3.5 km and 28.00%, read from gps_trace.trace_distance_km 16.0 over optimal_distance_km 12.5, which satisfies POL-RD-01's establishment tests, but it does not reach materiality: 3.5 km is under the 8.0 km absolute material threshold and 28.00% is under the 50% material threshold. On a non-material deviation POL-RD-06 is not engaged, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral from this trip.

In any event the POL-RD-06 pattern test fails on the driver's own profile: deviation_flags_90d is 0, below the trigger of 3 or more, and 0 divided by completed_trips_90d of 610 is 0.000, below the 0.05 ratio, with the 40-trip minimum satisfied. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so none of limbs (a), (b) or (c) of POL-RD-06 follows, and POL-GEN-01 confines this test to those two named fields alone.

The one live rider point is the ERP line, and the driver does not dispute it: EV-GPS-09114's derived erp_gantry_proximity block places the closest fix 7482.07 m from the gantry 'Bukit Merah Central westbound', records on_optimal_route false and gap_brackets_closest_approach false, and the driver's own counterparty statement says he did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt. The 3.20 line is therefore a phantom pass-through on this record, and the standalone correction under POL-RD-09(4) is the full extent of the driver's exposure in this brief.

That correction cannot be compounded: EV-FARE-09114 publishes a pol_rd_11_remedy of exactly 3.20, being charged_total 25.20 less quoted_fare 22.00 less properly chargeable pass-throughs of 0.00, and POL-RD-09(1) and POL-RD-11(b) forbid counting the same off-route line twice. The most that can move in this dispute is 3.20, not any sum enlarged by a duplicated ERP figure.

The case should be decided on the money rather than escalated: the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-TRIP-09114, EV-GPS-09114, EV-FARE-09114) are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not breached; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) (169 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval, max_gap_sec 0.0, coverage_pct 100.0); POL-RD-09(4) states that POL-RD-10(8) is not triggered where the only unmatched line is the one refunded under that limb; and no party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-10(5) and POL-RD-13 have nothing to act on.

Nothing on this record supports further money movement in either direction: EV-FARE-09114 bills distance_charged_km 16.0 against a trace_distance_km of 16.0, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall above 1.0 km to compensate under POL-RD-04, and the sole rider message in EV-CHAT-09114 asks why the fare carries an ERP line and names no road or place, with waypoint_hint null, so no rider-requested detour is recorded. The dispute is confined to the 3.20 pass-through correction under POL-RD-11.

The one live item is the ERP line, and there the driver does not contest the rider's point. EV-FARE-09114 bills SGD 3.20 for the gantry 'Bukit Merah Central westbound' (lat 1.34, lng 103.78). EV-GPS-09114 places the trace's closest approach 7,482.07 m from that gantry (fix index 65, 2026-09-21T11:40:50), with on_optimal_route false and gap_brackets_closest_approach false — roughly thirty times POL-RD-09(4)'s 250 m crossing radius. The amount is read off the fare breakdown: charged_total 25.20 less quoted_fare 22.00 less properly chargeable pass-throughs 0.00 = SGD 3.20, which is the published pol_rd_11_remedy and rounds (up to the nearest SGD 0.05) to SGD 3.20. ruling.explanation: Both parties agree on the substance, and the record supports them. THE CHARGE. Trip TRP-09114 was booked on an upfront quote of SGD 22.00 and charged SGD 25.20 — SGD 3.20 more. The whole of that difference is one ERP line, SGD 3.20 for the gantry 'Bukit Merah Central westbound' (charged 2026-09-21 11:43). The GPS trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c): 169 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so no corroboration beyond the trace is needed. The closest any fix comes to that gantry is 7,482.07 m (fix 65 at 11:40:50) — about thirty times the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09(4) applies — and the derived facts record on_optimal_route false and gap_brackets_closest_approach false. The driver's own statement on file also concedes he did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt. That is a billing-integrity failure, and POL-RD-09(4) refunds the line in full as a standalone correction. THE AMOUNT. This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip, so POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and no distance-or-time refund arises however long the route was. The remedy is the amount by which charged_total exceeds quoted_fare_sgd plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09 — no ERP crossed, no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee: 25.20 - 22.00 - 0.00 = SGD 3.20. The fare breakdown publishes the same figure as pol_rd_11_remedy (SGD 3.20). The phantom line is counted once only, not twice: POL-RD-09(1) and POL-RD-11(b) forbid refunding the same off-route line on top of itself. The refund is SGD 3.20, which is the whole of the contested amount, so the outcome for the filing party is FULL_REFUND. CLAIMS ADDRESSED. The rider's claims that the ERP line is a phantom charge and that a deviation is established (trace_distance_km 16.0 against the booked optimal 12.5, an excess of 3.5 km / 28.00%) are accepted; the deviation is established but not MATERIAL, and under POL-RD-11 it moves no money. The driver's claims that POL-RD-02 does not run, that the rider's exposure is confined to the single pass-through line and that the correction is SGD 3.20 are accepted. The rider's request for FULL_REFUND of the contested SGD 3.20 and for a billing-integrity referral is accepted. NO DRIVER COMPENSATION is due: the fare bills distance_charged_km 16.0 against a trace_distance_km of 16.0, so there is no unbilled shortfall above 1.0 km under POL-RD-04, and the sole chat message names no road or place (waypoint_hint null), so no rider-requested detour is recorded. NO POL-RD-06 DRIVER-CONDUCT REFERRAL arises: the deviation is not MATERIAL (28.00% is below the 50% gate, 3.5 km below the 8.0 km gate) and the profile test fails on its own terms (deviation_flags_90d 0 against 610 completed trips in 90 days), so none of POL-RD-06(a)-(c) follows. The referral below is produced by POL-RD-09(4), which adds to the money and does not displace it. THE DRIVER'S EXCUSE. His remark that the route was longer than expected is unsupported: he cites no advisory and none is on file — the only advisory identifier in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-09114-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no payload — so under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 it reduces nothing. This does not escalate under POL-RD-10(5): the asserting party named no advisory evidence ID, and POL-RD-13(1) treats the absence of an uncited artifact as a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires — the trip identifiers all match, no timestamps disagree, the trace is not impaired, and the only unmatched charge line is the one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-09(4) expressly excludes from POL-RD-10(8). CONFIDENCE. The deciding facts — the SGD 3.20 over-quote difference and the ERP line's non-crossing — are carried by EV-FARE-09114 and EV-GPS-09114, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 (the counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier and enters neither the minimum nor the maximum). The POL-GEN-02(2) cap is therefore 1.0, above the 0.70 floor, and confidence is 0.95.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the disputed SGD 3.20 ERP line is refunded in full, and the case is decided on the money rather than escalated.

Why the refund is due. The trip was booked upfront. EV-FARE-09114 records fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd SGD 22.00 and total_charged SGD 25.20. The whole SGD 3.20 difference is a single ERP line, 'Bukit Merah Central westbound'. On an upfront-quoted trip POL-RD-11 governs: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the measured excess. The rider's remedy is the amount by which the charge exceeds the quote plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09; the platform's own arithmetic publishes pol_rd_11_remedy of SGD 25.20 − SGD 22.00 − SGD 0.00 = SGD 3.20 (properly_chargeable.total SGD 0.00). Independently, POL-RD-09(4) makes this line refundable in full as a billing-integrity correction: the GPS trace EV-GPS-09114 (169 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps) comes no closer than 7,482.07 m to the gantry — about thirty times the 250 m crossing radius — and the driver's own statement on file records that he did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt. The two routes to the money are the same SGD 3.20, not two payments.

What does not move. The deviation is established under POL-RD-01 (trace_distance_km 16.0 against the booked optimal of 12.5 km = 3.5 km, 28.00%; both establishment gates pass) but it is not MATERIAL (28.00% is below the 50% gate and 3.5 km below the 8.0 km gate), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged, no FULL_REFUND uplift runs and no driver-conduct referral arises — and on an upfront-quoted trip no distance refund arises in any event. There is no unbilled-distance shortfall (distance_charged_km 16.0 equals the trace's 16.0 km), so no POL-RD-04 compensation is due. The sole chat message in EV-CHAT-09114 asks why the fare carries an ERP line, names no road or place, and has waypoint_hint null, so no rider-requested detour is recorded. EV-ADVIS-09114-01 is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no fact; no party relies on it.

Confidence. The deciding facts — that the gantry was never crossed and that the charge exceeds the quote by SGD 3.20 — are carried by EV-GPS-09114 and EV-FARE-09114, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not approached. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match, the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), the timestamps agree, and POL-RD-09(4) keeps the only unmatched charge line out of POL-RD-10(8).

On the claims, answered together: both sides agree the trip is upfront-quoted, that POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance refund is available, that the deviation is established but non-material, that the trace is unimpaired, that the corrected figure is SGD 3.20, and that the case should be decided rather than escalated — all accepted, and they support the refund. The rider's request for FULL_REFUND of the contested amount is accepted because the whole SGD 3.20 in dispute is returned to the filing party. The rider's suggestion of a POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral is rejected: POL-RD-06 is not engaged on a non-material deviation and the driver's profile shows no pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 over completed_trips_90d 610). The driver's points that no distance refund, no materiality uplift and no unbilled-distance compensation arise, and that the correction cannot be compounded, are likewise accepted.

Referral. Under POL-RD-09(4) the phantom gantry line is recorded as a billing-integrity finding and referred for review, as set out in the referrals list.

ledger.claim: This trip was booked on an UPFRONT_QUOTE: the fare was fixed at SGD 22.00 at booking, yet the rider was charged SGD 25.20 — SGD 3.20 more than the quote, and the whole of that difference is a single ERP line. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges on an upfront trip were fixed at booking and cannot move, so the only live question is whether the pass-through lines billed on top of the quote were properly chargeable.

POL-RD-11(a) measures the rider's remedy as charged_total less quoted_fare_sgd less the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. The fare_breakdown's own arithmetic publishes properly_chargeable.total at SGD 0.00 — no ERP line crossed, no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee — so the remedy is the full SGD 3.20 by which the SGD 25.20 charged exceeds the SGD 22.00 quote, and the published pol_rd_11_remedy is SGD 3.20.

The ERP line is a phantom line on this trip's own trace. The charged gantry, 'Bukit Merah Central westbound', sits at lat 1.34, lng 103.78; the closest any of the trace's 169 fixes comes to it is 7,482.07 m (fix index 65, 2026-09-21T11:40:50) — roughly thirty times the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09(4) applies — and the derived facts record gap_brackets_closest_approach false and on_optimal_route false. A charge line for a gantry the trace never passes is a billing-integrity failure refunded in full under POL-RD-09(4), and that correction is available whether or not a deviation exists.

The driver does not contest the gantry point. His statement on file records that the route was longer than expected but that he 'did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt'. That is a party admission on the very line in dispute, and it corroborates the billing-integrity defect independently of the platform trace.

The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The POL-RD-01 governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 16.0 km, against the booked optimal of 12.5 km — an excess of 3.5 km, or 28.00%. Both establishment tests pass: 28.00% is above the 20% threshold and 3.5 km is above the 0.8 km threshold. That discharges the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) and (b) on matching identifiers and a threshold-meeting excess.

Because POL-RD-11 governs this upfront-quoted trip, POL-RD-02 does not run and the rider claims no distance-or-time refund — the rider is not asking for money the upfront quote never put at risk. The remedy sought is the pass-through correction alone, which is why the amount claimed is exactly the contested SGD 3.20.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 169 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, and max_gap_sec of 0.0, with an admissibility status of COMPLETE at weight 1.0. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are therefore not met, the excess stands on the trace itself without independent corroboration, and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged.

No traffic advisory covers this trip window, so nothing in the bundle reduces the measured excess or supplies an amended optimal under POL-RD-03. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09114-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no payload — I disclose that impairment expressly — and its absence is itself citable. It leaves the driver with no exculpatory clause to invoke under POL-RD-08, and under POL-RD-13 an uncited traffic explanation carries no weight against the trace figure.

ledger.claim: The rider-side corroboration rule in POL-RD-08 is nowhere near engaged: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far below the four-claim trigger, so the trace figure needs no supporting source beyond itself.

The refund the rider seeks does not depend on materiality or on a repeat pattern, and I do not overstate either: POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation here but not a MATERIAL one — 28.00% is below the 50% gate and 3.5 km below the 8.0 km gate — and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, with deviation_flags_90d at 0 against 610 completed trips in 90 days, yields no pattern. The billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) is owed on this record either way.

The whole of the contested SGD 3.20 is returned to the rider, so the outcome for the filing party is FULL_REFUND under POL-GEN-03, and the phantom-gantry charge should additionally be recorded as a billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4). That referral adds to the monetary ruling and does not suppress it, and POL-RD-10(8) is not triggered because the only unmatched line in the fare_breakdown is the one already refunded under POL-RD-09(4).

This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: EV-FARE-09114 carries fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 22.00 against a total_charged of 25.20, so under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run on this trip, and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however large the measured excess. The driver keeps the quoted 22.00 and the rider's exposure is confined to the single pass-through line.

The excess is 3.5 km and 28.00%, read from gps_trace.trace_distance_km 16.0 over optimal_distance_km 12.5, which satisfies POL-RD-01's establishment tests, but it does not reach materiality: 3.5 km is under the 8.0 km absolute material threshold and 28.00% is under the 50% material threshold. On a non-material deviation POL-RD-06 is not engaged, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral from this trip.

In any event the POL-RD-06 pattern test fails on the driver's own profile: deviation_flags_90d is 0, below the trigger of 3 or more, and 0 divided by completed_trips_90d of 610 is 0.000, below the 0.05 ratio, with the 40-trip minimum satisfied. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so none of limbs (a), (b) or (c) of POL-RD-06 follows, and POL-GEN-01 confines this test to those two named fields alone.

The one live rider point is the ERP line, and the driver does not dispute it: EV-GPS-09114's derived erp_gantry_proximity block places the closest fix 7482.07 m from the gantry 'Bukit Merah Central westbound', records on_optimal_route false and gap_brackets_closest_approach false, and the driver's own counterparty statement says he did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt. The 3.20 line is therefore a phantom pass-through on this record, and the standalone correction under POL-RD-09(4) is the full extent of the driver's exposure in this brief.

That correction cannot be compounded: EV-FARE-09114 publishes a pol_rd_11_remedy of exactly 3.20, being charged_total 25.20 less quoted_fare 22.00 less properly chargeable pass-throughs of 0.00, and POL-RD-09(1) and POL-RD-11(b) forbid counting the same off-route line twice. The most that can move in this dispute is 3.20, not any sum enlarged by a duplicated ERP figure.

The case should be decided on the money rather than escalated: the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-TRIP-09114, EV-GPS-09114, EV-FARE-09114) are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not breached; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) (169 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval, max_gap_sec 0.0, coverage_pct 100.0); POL-RD-09(4) states that POL-RD-10(8) is not triggered where the only unmatched line is the one refunded under that limb; and no party asserts an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-10(5) and POL-RD-13 have nothing to act on.

Nothing on this record supports further money movement in either direction: EV-FARE-09114 bills distance_charged_km 16.0 against a trace_distance_km of 16.0, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall above 1.0 km to compensate under POL-RD-04, and the sole rider message in EV-CHAT-09114 asks why the fare carries an ERP line and names no road or place, with waypoint_hint null, so no rider-requested detour is recorded. The dispute is confined to the 3.20 pass-through correction under POL-RD-11.
